name: Inverse Volatility Weighted Portfolio (SPY/TLT/GLD/DBC)
description: Weekly rebalanced long-only portfolio across SPY, TLT, GLD, and DBC using inverse volatility weighting. 63-day realized volatility (annualized) determines each asset's weight — lower vol assets get higher allocation. Rebalances every Monday. No trend filter, no stops, no leverage. Measures risk-adjusted returns and drawdown across full history.
source:
# =============================================================================
# Inverse Volatility Weighted Portfolio — SPY / TLT / GLD / DBC
# Always long all 4 ETFs, rebalanced weekly using inverse-vol weights.
# 63-day annualized realized vol determines allocation.
# =============================================================================

# --- Data ---
src = study_assets()

# --- Volatility ---
# 63-day annualized realized volatility per asset
vol_63 = volatility(src.c, method=VolMethod.annualized, period=63)

# --- Allocation ---
# All assets always active (unconditional hold)
always_active = is_valid(src.c)

# Inverse volatility weights — cross-sectional, normalized to sum to 1
w = inv_vol_weight(max_weight=1.0, min_volatility=0.0)(active_mask=always_active, volatility=vol_63)

# --- Rebalance Trigger ---
# Weekly rebalance on Monday (every ~5 trading days)
rebal = day_of_week(DayOfWeek.Monday)

# --- Execution ---
# Long-only: always hold all 4 assets
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=always_active)

# Size by inverse-vol weight, rebalance weekly
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=w.weight * 100, rebalance_on=rebal)
